features: Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) integration into Razorpay OmniChannel Stack
Support for both online and offline merchants
Real-time currency conversion with transparent exchange rates
Revenue sharing for merchants through DCC markup
Unified dashboard for transaction reconciliation across channels
Support for aggregator merchants via Hitachi-RBL BIN Sponsorship Model
Customer opt-in/out for DCC at POS terminals and online checkout
Integration with Razorpay Cross-Border Payments Suite
goals: Provide a unified DCC solution across online and offline payment channels
Reduce reliance on third-party DCC providers to capture larger revenue share
Enhance merchant adoption and retention through seamless integration
Improve operational efficiency by reducing tech stack fragmentation
Ensure compliance with international payment standards
Deliver transparent and frictionless payment experiences for international customers
apis: POS API for detecting international card transactions and enabling DCC opt-in/out
Online Checkout API for displaying INR and home currency prices
Exchange Rate API for fetching real-time currency conversion rates
Transaction Reconciliation API for unified dashboard integration
Cross-Border Payments API for seamless integration with existing suite
Merchant Configuration API for enabling DCC on supported devices
recommended_tech_stack: Redis (caching exchange rates and session data)

service_mapping.Customer Opt-in/Out Flow: POS Service and Online Checkout Service

data_flow: Customer initiates payment at POS or online checkout
System detects international card and fetches real-time exchange rate
Transaction is processed in INR or home currency based on customer choice
Transaction details are stored and reconciled in the unified dashboard

edge_cases: Exchange rate API downtime leading to inability to fetch real-time rates
Customer confusion about DCC opt-in/out flow, requiring clear UI/UX design
Fraudulent transactions using international cards, requiring enhanced security checks
Compliance with international payment regulations for currency conversion
Handling refunds and reversals for DCC transactions
Ensuring accurate reconciliation of DCC and non-DCC transactions in the dashboard
Support for non-Android POS devices in future phases
